blocks.text: Apple’s Privacy Manifest is now mandatory for all iOS apps.

Apple's Privacy Manifest includes three main components:

: Specify the types of data your app collects, why it's collected, any privacy-sensitive APIs it uses, and any third-party SDKs integrated into the app. You must also provide a clear business reason for each.
: List all external domains your app communicates with, explain the purpose of the communication, and detail the security measures in place.
: Follow Apple's required JSON structure for the manifest and ensure it's embedded in both your app bundle and any live-update packages.
